SELECT T.* FROM (SELECT A.*, B.METHODNAME, B.TESTMETHODBASIS, B.MAXVERSIONID AS METHODVERSIONID, D.STDNAME, E.INDEXNAME, E.INDEX1, E.INDEX2, E.INDEX3, F.TESTMETHODID, G.TESTNAME FROM T_EMC_PROJ_ORDER_CHANGE A LEFT JOIN T_EMC_METHOD B ON A.METHODID = B.ID LEFT JOIN T_EMC_INDEX_CATEGORY D ON A.INDEXCATEGORYID = D.ID LEFT JOIN T_EMC_ORDER_INDEX E ON A.INDEXID = E.ID LEFT JOIN T_EMC_ITEM_GROUP F ON A.ITEMGROUPID = F.ID LEFT JOIN T_EMC_TEST G ON A.TESTID = G.ID) T
ORDER BY
T.ID ASC

SELECT A.ITEMGROUP AS ITEMGROUPS, B.MONITORPOINTCATEGORYNAME, B.MONITORPOINTNO, B.MONITORPOINTNAME, B.CYCLE, B.FREQUENCY, C.ORGNAME FROM T_EMC_PROJ_ORDER A LEFT JOIN T_EMC_PROJ_SCHEME B ON A.PROJSCHEMEID = B.ID LEFT JOIN T_CORE_ORG C ON B.SAMPLEORGID = C.ID WHERE B.PROJID=#{projId}
